description:
Result of running a stage's validator(s) against its output.

Minimum required per the runbook:
    - pass/fail
    - failure list

passed.description: Whether the stage's output passed validation.
passed.title: Passed

failures.description: Human-readable list of validation failures. Empty when passed=True. Examples: 'Voice duration mismatch', 'Missing captions', 'Invalid hash'.
failures.title: Failures

stage_id.description: Stage/gate this validation report applies to.
stage_id.title: Stage Id

title: ValidationReportV1
